issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a Lecture constructor that initializes five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, and the solution implements a constructor with five parameters in that order. However, the template repository provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This constructor parameter mismatch can confuse students about whether to modify the existing constructor signature or create an additional one, and may lead to implementing the wrong constructor order or forgetting attributes.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture class to either remove the three-parameter constructor stub or replace it with a constructor signature that matches the UML and solution (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and leave the body empty (TODO). This makes the intended constructor explicit and avoids student confusion about which constructor to implement.
